summary: Promoted the ask_user Pi extension into a paired package @gizmo/ask-user (mirror of @gizmo/unity) so its UI ships with it: the tool moved into packages/ask-user/pi-extension.ts and a new web extension (labels, parametersFor, resultFor -> AskUserToolResult.svelte) is registered as a static builtin alongside Svelte/Git/Activity. Verified with pnpm check, a new ask-user web extension test, and the full 46-test app suite; committed as 652a7b0.
decisions: Created packages/ask-user as a paired Pi + web extension package (Unity-style), rather than leaving ask_user as a shell-level tool.

Web extension registered as a static builtin (same shape as Svelte/Git/Activity) instead of runtime-delivered over extensions.web; the app's only knowledge is one import + array entry in registry.svelte.ts.
ask_user's display label moved out of the shell's base tool labels into the new extension's labels contribution.

AskUserToolResult.svelte renders the result natively (question, numbered options with pick highlighted, custom-answer mark, dismissed state); the interactive question card stays as the generic bridge renderer for any select/input request.
packages/ask-user has no tsconfig and is excluded from typecheck (source file is only consumed by the agent-server generator/seed).
errors: Vitest failed on the new ask-user test because the import path '../conversation/tool-labels' resolved to src/lib/conversation (wrong one level up); corrected to '../features/conversation/tool-labels' and tests passed (2/2).
